summary: A generic modern guided-missile destroyer: a 150 m haze-grey hull with a raked, flared bow, a bow sonar dome… joints search_radar, gun_turret, gun_elevation; sockets waterline, eye_point, seat_driver, helipad.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.naval_destroyer or place "prefab": "naval_destroyer" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
